### Encased by the Father’s Love
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/encased-by-the-fathers-love-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 139:5
Points:
- Emotional distress and confusion can make believers feel vulnerable to spiritual deception.
- David reflected on God's faithful protection and nearness after enduring years of hardship.
- The phrase describing God hemming us in recalls a shepherd hedging in sheep for their safety.
- The Father places His hand upon us to steer us away from danger while giving room to grow.
- Believers do not need to live in fear because God's loving presence surrounds them on all sides.

### God’s Intimate Knowledge
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/god-s-intimate-knowledge-today-s-insight-august-1-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 139:1-4
Points:
- People often battle feelings of insignificance in a massive, impersonal world.
- God actively explores and sifts through our daily routines, both when resting and when active.
- The Lord understands our unspoken motives, neurological thought processes, and words before we speak.
- Divine omniscience means God holds complete, detailed awareness of every individual at all times.
- Believers can take comfort in knowing they are the constant focus of God's personal attention.

### Our All-Knowing, All-Seeing Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-all-knowing-all-seeing-lord
Passage: Psalm 139:1-12
Points:
- God's omnipresence means He is fully present across all creation, leaving nowhere anyone could hide.
- Divine omniscience is personal and intimate, fully aware of every human action, thought, and future word.
- God's knowledge is not merely greater in quantity than ours, but qualitatively different and determinative of reality.
- Believers must avoid the presumption of imagining God's mind to be like limited human understanding.
- Meditating on God's infinite greatness produces reverence and deep comfort in His care.

### How Psalm 139 Pointed Me to Christ in My Suffering
Author: David Ayers
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/cancer-gave-me-joy/
Passage: Psalm 139:1-24
Points:
- Psalm 139 served as a sustaining anchor of joy through the shock and pain of cancer treatment.
- God already knows every fear and doubt we carry, yet His thoughts toward His sheep are loving and steadfast.
- The Lord does not abandon believers during medical agony or fear of death, but stays tangibly present.
- Recognizing that our bodies and all our days were fashioned by God removes bitterness and anger.
- God lovingly uses severe trials to search our hearts, root out sin, and advance sanctification.
